text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urgh… I guess it was impossible for you too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please don't let it bother you! It's all the puny claw's fault!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: If you could put me in there instead of that claw, I'd scoop out every last adorable plushie!
